Use E1/G1 ai_candidate needs_human_review; generation/authorship is no approval. Do not execute learner experiments or create private learner data.
Use current actual source operator/course/topic conditions. Original optional examples are not universally mandatory; owner broader authored-topic target does not claim a learner selected them.
Only edit profiles for owned existing goals. Others may be used read-only; if indispensable, send a precise proposed additive change/material reference to the owner instead of overwriting.

New atoms only where an existing goal cannot honestly carry the skill. Propose stable UUID5, full goal text, narrow required prerequisites, source scope, parent placement and semantic/memory decisions; no graph activation yet.
No new image generation at this author stage. Keep good current images; record only genuine new-context image needs for the independent integration stage.
Respect the unchanged profile schema including2000character case-brief scalars. Keep full materials separately bound; preflight before stock writer, no full builds or broad validation loops.
